scope: For every odd prime p and primitive p^s-th root q with 3p<p^s: actual P_{3p} and H_{3p} are squarefree and the original ordinary-square bilinear CD kernel is nonzero at every P_{3p} root.

p_ge_5_consequences.roots: 2p roots of valuation (2p-1)/(2p), p-1 roots of valuation 1, and simple zero; the last p roots have pairwise distance valuation 1

p_3_scope: Only the squarefreeness and original kernel conclusions at b=9, uniformly for s>=3; no generic valuation or discriminant formula asserted.
combined_range: 0<=b<=3p and b<p^s, using the independently accepted b<min(3p,p^s) theorem as a dependency.

independent_controls.p3_all_orders: Rational remainders/gcds for D and DiscQ at Phi27/Phi81 plus degree bound for all s>=5; independently matched candidate R14/E52, mod-2 remainder, and DiscP9 identity.

exclusions: No unrestricted F020 or all-A closure
No p=3 generic root-valuation or discriminant-valuation formula
